name: Stratholme Service Entrance
summary: The Stratholme Service Entrance is a fortified rear gateway located at Eastwall Gate in the northern Eastern Plaguelands. It provides direct, covert access into the Scourge-controlled eastern quarter of the burning city, bypassing the grand front gates.

sections.title: A Breached Bastion
sections.body: While the monumental Main Gate of Stratholme opens into King's Square and the crusader-held districts, the Service Entrance breaches the city's eastern fortification at Eastwall Gate. Today, it leads directly into the corrupted heart of the metropolis: Elders' Square and the blighted pathways leading toward Baron Rivendare's slaughterhouses.

sections.title: The Scourge Redoubt
sections.body: Venturing through the service portal avoids the Scarlet Crusade garrisons near the front entrance, plunging straight into Scourge territory. The surrounding alleys crawl with gargoyles, crypt fiends, and cultists guarding the dread ziggurats. For the Argent Dawn and daring adventurers seeking to strike at the ruling death knight directly, this hidden iron gate serves as the primary staging point for surgical strikes against the Lich King's commanders.

faq.q: Where is the Stratholme Service Entrance located?
aliases: how to find strat back door
faq.answer: The entrance is situated at Eastwall Gate, along the northern mountains of the Eastern Plaguelands, just east of the main ruins of Stratholme. It is tucked into a stone archway along the fortified wall.

faq.q: How does this entrance differ from the Stratholme Main Gate?
faq.answer: The Main Gate leads directly into the living and crusader-controlled ruins around King's Square, whereas the Service Entrance deposits you into Elders' Square, placing you on the doorstep of the undead-dominated wing and the road toward Slaughter Square.

faq.q: Why is it called the Service Entrance?
faq.answer: It is a rear entrance at Eastwall Gate that bypasses the city's front approach. Its original municipal use is not specified.

faq.q: Who controls this part of the city?
faq.answer: The district beyond the gate is firmly held by the Scourge, overseen by Baron Rivendare and his acolytes, who maintain the ziggurats anchoring their dark magic within Elders' Square.

angles.text: For knights of the Light, this threshold leads straight into the defiled necromantic apparatus of the Scourge, offering a direct path to purge Rivendare and reclaim the holy city's fallen honor.
The service gate embodies classic tactical infiltration, allowing adventurers to bypass fortified battle lines and slip quietly into the city's utility corridors.
